title: Crew Gap Calculator
one_liner: Estimate how many licensed electricians a data center build needs per phase and where staffing will slip the schedule.
headline: Enter your data center's size, target energization date and committed crew to see a month-by-month electrician shortfall chart and download a draft job post for the worst gap.

episode.title: Chamath: AGI Is Here, Anthropic’s $100B Giveaway, Elon’s SpaceX Shares for 72M Kids | EP #304

history.summary: A clean, fully self-contained staffing calculator that genuinely computes its output from the user's own inputs and editable assumptions — nothing canned. It closely matches both the episode moment and the pitched "Livewire Bench" opportunity, with internally consistent math (verified the ramp model, peak values, and job-description export all line up), labeled assumptions, and a correctly attributed single podcast quote. Solid, publishable work with only minor polish items left.
